course.title: Unit 2 Last weekend-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（What did you do last weekend?）

sentences.content: I want to buy the new film magazine. Oh, I read it last weekend.
sentences.english: I want to buy the new film magazine . Oh , I read it last weekend
sentences.chinese: 我想买那本新出的电影杂志。哦，我上周末已经看过了。

sentences.content: Was it interesting? Yes, it talked about a lot of new films.
sentences.english: Was it interesting ? Yes , it talked about a lot of new films
sentences.chinese: 有趣吗？是的，它讲了很多新电影。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: Did you see a film? No, I had a cold. I stayed at home all weekend and slept.
sentences.english: Did you see a film ? No , I had a cold . I stayed at home all weekend and slept
sentences.chinese: 你看电影了吗？没有，我感冒了。整个周末我都待在家里睡觉。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: Let’s go by bus. It’s faster than walking.
sentences.english: Let's go by bus . It's faster than walking
sentences.chinese: 我们坐公交车去吧，比走路快。

sentences.content: Wu Binbin’s family stayed at the Holiday Hotel. Their weekend was bad.
sentences.english: Wu Binbin's family stayed at the Holiday Hotel . Their weekend was bad
sentences.chinese: Wu Binbin一家住在Holiday Hotel。他们的周末过得很糟糕。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: Our room was big but everything was very old. Robin cleaned our room and fixed a broken chair.
sentences.english: Our room was big but everything was very old . Robin cleaned our room and fixed a broken chair
sentences.chinese: 我们的房间很大，但所有东西都很陈旧。Robin打扫了我们的房间，还修好了一把坏掉的椅子。

sentences.content: The lamp was too small. The TV didn’t work.
sentences.english: The lamp was too small . The TV didn't work
sentences.chinese: 台灯太小了。电视机坏了。

sentences.english: The people in Room 301 listened to loud music . I didn't sleep all night
sentences.chinese: 301房间的人放着震耳欲聋的音乐，害得我一整夜都没睡着。

sentences.content: What did John do yesterday? He slept and had a cold.
sentences.english: What did John do yesterday ? He slept and had a cold
sentences.chinese: John昨天做了什么？他睡了一觉，还感冒了。
